# @xzy-ai/opencode-commandcode-provider

Command Code provider plugin for opencode.

## Installation

```sh
npm install @xzy-ai/opencode-commandcode-provider
```

## Configuration

Add the plugin and provider to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["@xzy-ai/opencode-commandcode-provider"],
  "provider": {
    "commandcode": {
      "npm": "@xzy-ai/opencode-commandcode-provider"
    }
  }
}
```

Optional environment variables:

- `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`
- `COMMANDCODE_API_BASE`
- `COMMANDCODE_MODELS_URL`
- `COMMANDCODE_CONTEXT_OVERRIDES_PATH`
